text:
nora_hires: Hi team, quick Q - my international adoption was finalized on 2025-04-02 (court in the Philippines). How do I add my adopted son to benefits and can we get coverage retroactive to the court date?

jess_benefits: Congrats Nora! For international adoption we need: final adoption decree, child's foreign birth certificate, child's passport, USCIS adoption paperwork (I-800/I-801 or IR3/IR4 docs), and an English translation if any doc is not in English.

nora_hires: I have the IR3 and apostilled court decree. The adoption paperwork lists his original DOB 2024-11-12. Can retro be back to the court finalization date 2025-04-02 or the DOB?

sam_hr: Generally carrier QLE effective dates for adoption are carrier-dependent: some carriers allow retro to the adoption finalization date, others to the date of placement or first court action. We’ll submit for retro to 2025-04-02 per your request and note the DOB as supporting info.

nora_hires: Good to know. Where do I upload? I don’t want to email SSN.

jess_benefits: Use Workday > Benefits > Manage Dependents > Add Dependent > Upload Documents. For SSN: we will request full SSN via a secure intake link once enrollment is in process. For initial intake last 4 is ok.

nora_hires: What about daycare/medical bills since April? I already had a pediatric visit on 2025-04-10 and got billed.

lena_legal: For claims during pendency, carriers sometimes accept retro enrollment and reprocess claims back to the requested effective date. Please include copies of itemized bills and superbills with your intake so benefits can submit reprocessing requests if approval is granted.

jess_benefits: Also include proof of placement if you have it (placement letter from agency) and any immigration entry date. Those help with carrier adjudication.

nora_hires: Okay uploading: decree, IR3, passport scan, placement_letter_032025.pdf, pediatric_bill_041025.pdf.

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: #HR-87122 (Adoption intake). Benefits specialist assigned: jess_benefits. Expect initial carrier submission in 2 business days.

jess_benefits: One more note: if carrier asks for SSN for enrollment and you don't have one yet, we can provisionally enroll and then update once SSN issued. For international adoptions sometimes SSN comes after entry. If no SSN, attach a note with expected SSN issuance timeline.

nora_hires: SSN application submitted with passport when we entered the US on 2025-03-28. Should be 2-3 weeks.

sam_hr: Perfect. We'll mark the enrollment as pending SSN and request retro effective 2025-04-02. If carrier needs more docs we will loop you in.

jess_benefits: For the pediatric bill: hold off on paying any balances until we confirm carrier reprocessing. We'll submit that bill with the retro request.

nora_hires: If carrier denies retro, can claims still be appealed?

lena_legal: Yes. If carrier denies on plan rules, benefits/legal can file an appeal citing adoption timelines and supporting docs. Appeals sometimes win for adoption cases. We'll support evidence and escalate to carrier medical review if needed.

nora_hires: Thanks. Also wondering about FSA eligibility changes and childcare benefits - do those need separate QLE forms?

sam_hr: Yes, adding a dependent via adoption qualifies for midyear FSA/HSA election changes. After enrollment completes we’ll send you the election change link and payroll deadlines. For dependent care FSA you can start contributions once the dependent is on plan.

jess_benefits: ETA: I'll submit to carrier today and flag as adoption retro request. I’ll post the carrier confirmation number here when I get it.

people-ops-bot: Update logged: #HR-87122 - docs received and queued for carrier submission.

nora_hires: Really appreciate it - sending a separate note if SSN delays beyond 3 weeks. Thanks all! :heart:
